title: No-Show Terms on a Ticket Held in an Air Ticket Fare Brand
content:
A traveller who neither flies nor cancels before the outbound departure is recorded as a no-show.

## 1. The return leg

A no-show on the outbound leaves the return leg unusable on every brand, and the return is treated as cancelled on the brand's own terms once the no-show penalty has been withheld.

## 2. One penalty, never two

A cancellation penalty and a no-show penalty are never withheld against the same ticket: whichever applies replaces the other.

## 3. Where the airline is at fault

A penalty is never withheld where the traveller could not travel because the airline did not operate the flight, and the disruption terms apply instead.

## 4. Discounted travellers

The infant share of a fare and the child discount are applied before the penalty is measured, so the penalty is never larger than what that traveller actually paid.

## 5. Clauses no longer in force

> "the no-show penalty of the fare brand held is withheld from whatever value the ticket still carries"

That clause is **no longer in force**. The handling basis it stated has been superseded by the basis now governing the sum withheld as a no-show penalty on Air Ticket Fare Brands bookings. The brand values scheduled under this policy are unaffected and stand as stated.

> "Where the value still on the ticket is smaller than the penalty, the penalty is limited to that value and no balance is pursued."

That clause is **no longer in force**. The handling basis it stated has been superseded by the basis now governing the sum withheld as a no-show penalty on Air Ticket Fare Brands bookings. The brand values scheduled under this policy are unaffected and stand as stated.

The basis those two clauses carried — the brand's own penalty withheld from whatever value the ticket still carried, and the penalty limited to that value where the value was the smaller of the two, with no balance pursued — is retired with them. Sections 1 to 4 are unaffected and remain in force, and the no-show penalty scheduled for each brand remains that brand's own value.

## 6. Points of judgement

**A traveller misses the outbound and asks to keep the return.** Section 1 governs: the return is unusable on every brand and is treated as cancelled on the brand's own terms, once the penalty has been withheld.

**The airline did not operate the flight.** Section 3 governs, and no penalty is withheld at all; the disruption terms decide what follows.
